hero.title: Design String Art Online — Free String Art Editor & Generator
hero.subtitle: Turn a circle, oval, rectangle, square, or triangle into a pin-and-thread string art pattern, right in your browser. Place pins, connect threads across layers, and print a ready-to-build template — free, with no signup and no download.

shapes.title: Any board shape
shapes.description: Start from a circle, oval, rectangle, square, or triangle with your own physical dimensions.

pins.title: Precise pin placement
pins.description: Distribute pins evenly along lines, arcs, polygons, and stars with exact spacing control.

threads.title: Multi-layer threading
threads.description: Connect pins with single- or multi-colour threads, organised across separate thread layers.

layers.title: Pin & thread layers
layers.description: Keep pins and threads organised in their own layers, with visibility and locking.

undo.title: Full undo history
undo.description: Every change is undoable and redoable, so you can experiment freely.

print.title: Print-ready templates
print.description: Export a print-ready template with pin numbers and guides for building the real thing.

setup.title: Set up your board
setup.description: Choose a shape and enter its real-world dimensions and appearance.

pins.title: Place your pins
pins.description: Draw pin paths with precise, evenly spaced pin placement.

threads.title: Connect the threads
threads.description: Draw thread paths between pins across as many layers as you like.

print.title: Export & print
print.description: Print a build template, or save your project to keep working on it later.

whatIsStringArt.question: What is string art?
whatIsStringArt.answer: String art is a technique where thread or string is wound between pins or nails arranged on a board to form geometric patterns and images. StringArtIt lets you design that pin-and-thread layout digitally before building it physically.

isFree.question: Is StringArtIt free to use?
isFree.answer: Yes. StringArtIt runs entirely in your browser and is free to use, with no signup required.

needsAccount.question: Do I need to create an account?
needsAccount.answer: No account is needed. Your project stays in your browser, and you can save it to a file to reopen later.

shapes.question: What board shapes are supported?
shapes.answer: Circle, oval, rectangle, square, and triangle boards, each with custom real-world dimensions and appearance.

print.question: Can I print a template to build the real string art?
print.answer: Yes. The Print Preview generates a build template showing pins, guides, and pin numbers, printable at 1:1 scale or fit to page.

saveProject.question: Can I save my project and come back later?
saveProject.answer: Yes. You can save your project to a file and reopen it later, and an autosave will offer to restore unsaved work if you leave the page.

symmetry.question: Does StringArtIt support symmetrical patterns?
symmetry.answer: Yes. Horizontal, vertical, both, and radial symmetry tools let you draw once and generate mirrored or radial copies automatically.
